title: Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire
body: Teaching was already happening at Oxford by 1096, and the university grew quickly after 1167. The Mexica founded their island city of Tenochtitlan around 1325, and the Triple Alliance we call the Aztec Empire only formed in 1428. We tend to file the Aztecs under ‘ancient’ and Oxford under ‘modern’, but Oxford was already more than 300 years old when the alliance was born.

slides.heading: Oxford and the Aztecs on one timeline
slides.note: Oxford was more than 300 years old when the Triple Alliance formed.

slides.question: In what year did the Triple Alliance we call the Aztec Empire form?
slides.explanation: 1428, by which time Oxford was already more than 300 years old. Tenochtitlan itself was founded only around 1325.

slides.heading: Oxford or the Aztecs?
slides.explanation: Oxford: teaching by 1096, rapid growth after 1167. The Mexica founded Tenochtitlan around 1325; the Triple Alliance we call the Aztec Empire formed in 1428.
